text: {"findings":[{"rule_id":"MF-005","evidence":[{"kind":"title_block","ref":"heat_treatment","page":1,"quote":"---"},{"kind":"note","ref":"N2","page":1,"quote":"HEAT TREATMENT :- 1) TO BE TOUGHENED UPTO 24-32 HRC. 2) RETAPPING TO BE DONE AFTER SURFACE TREATMENT AT SUPPLIER END.( IF APPLICABLE )"}],"comment":"The title-block heat_treatment field is '---', contradicting note N2 which specifies hardening to 24-32 HRC, and neither the title block nor the note states at what manufacturing stage the heat treatment applies. This ambiguity can cause the supplier to apply the treatment at the wrong stage, distorting finished features. Update the heat_treatment field to match N2 and add the process stage (e.g., after rough machining, before finish grinding).","recommended_correction":"Update the heat_treatment field to reflect the requirement in N2 and specify the manufacturing stage at which the heat treatment is to be applied."}]}
